contract.stateTransitions: Advance only after successful actual interaction or a source-complete simulated action whose guards are all true. Unknown flags stay unknown. Never infer completed preparations from rank/date alone.
contract.calendar: Exact-date availability is mandatory; regular post-unlock weekdays do not automatically govern every pre-unlock conversation. Current offered interaction is acceptable evidence.
contract.costs: All JPY costs are in-game currency. Consume items/money once on successful transition; never double-charge already-completed observed preparation. Purchase and giving are distinct.
contract.slotCost: 0 means no additional optional-slot consumption; embedded events require parent action cost already accounted. null means unresolved, not0 or1.
contract.distinctDates: Compare game ordinals. Exact historical date is optional: with known prep stage and unknown last date, use checkpoint date as conservative upper bound; schedule next distinct date after it. Same-day execution requires current-day completion timing confirmation.
contract.idempotency: A transition applies once from its exact fromStage; repeated tool/event delivery cannot spend again.
contract.affinity: Opening event rank1 only. No invented affinity credit.
contract.chinese: Exact existing guide/audited display only; foreign dialogue never translated into purported Chinese game text.
contract.sourceEnvelope: Optional sufficient gate under competing reports, default-off. Lower values cannot be labelled impossible.
contract.partialInteractions: Maiko food-only state is supported without consuming food twice. Interrupted Tower/Moon opening may be recorded as external observed progress; the aggregate rule cannot assume all substeps succeeded.

models.unknownStatePolicy: Unknown is not stage0; use observed preparation flags or ask for current state. Never repay or consume an item from assumed history.
